summary: A Svelte one-pager for a compressed display family inspired by Italian shop signs, alternating tomato-red and sage-green sections under thick charcoal rules. Vintage hotel and shop-sign stickers set in the font are scattered over every section, draggable and switchable from a 'Shop Signs' toggle in the nav; the page closes on a wall of pastiche foundry specimen pages.

instances.look: On tomato red, under a thick charcoal rule: the pitch 'A compressed display typeface inspired by Italian shop signs & woodtype tradition.' in charcoal Bold, then the table of contents as two columns of large white Light words (Weights & Sizes, Principles, Alphabet, Try yourself, Story / Foundry type specimens, Italian shops & hotels, Buy & Download), with vintage hotel stickers (Hotel Isotta Naples, Berlin Hilton, Capo Ufficio Veicoli, Olio di Semi) scattered lower right
instances.ux: Menu items stagger in on load (translate + fade); clicking scrolls to the section; stickers can be dragged
instances.learn: Set the table of contents itself at display size in the light weight: the hero menu is both navigation and a second specimen beside the bold pitch

reconstruction.layout: Full-screen section (~1012px); 48px side margins; 28px charcoal rule full content width at top; headline 2 lines across ~1340px; menu in two columns at x=48 and x≈380 from y≈280; stickers absolutely placed in the right half (200–260px each)
reconstruction.typography: Headline ~96px Arteria Bold charcoal #3b3a36, leading ~1.0; menu ~72px Arteria Light (Thin-ish) white, leading ~1.1; sticker lettering in many Arteria weights
reconstruction.behaviour: Loader (dark screen) <1s, then menu items fade/slide in one after another (GSAP); stickers drift slightly with a per-label transform and are draggable (pointer events, touch-action none)
reconstruction.content: Real positioning line and section names
reconstruction.assets: Sticker PNGs of fictional Italian hotel labels and shop signs lettered in Arteria
reconstruction.html: section#home.red.fullscreen > .labels-grid > .label > img (draggable) + .content-inner > .title-line + h1 + ul > li.menu-item > a

instances.look: About 15 vintage stickers scattered across the sections, overlapping the content: round and shield-shaped hotel luggage labels (Hotel Isotta Genève, Palmes Palermo, Princesse Hotel Evian, Guglielmina Grand Hotel, Alicante) and enamel-style shop signs (Macelleria con vendita, Dirigente Movimento, Univers Napoli, Panafico), all lettered in Arteria
instances.feel: Collectible, like a suitcase covered in labels
instances.ux: Each sticker can be dragged around the page; the 'Shop Signs' checkbox in the fixed nav hides or shows them all
instances.learn: Treat the in-use props as a removable layer: draggable stickers scattered over the specimen, with one nav toggle for readers who want them out of the way

reconstruction.layout: Each section has an absolutely positioned 12-column .labels-grid; each sticker sits in a grid column span with a top % offset and z-index 3, 150–300px wide, overlapping text and samples
reconstruction.typography: Sticker lettering set in Arteria Thin to Black, caps, tracked, in red, green, charcoal and cream
reconstruction.behaviour: Pointer drag moves a sticker (touch-action none, cursor pointer); a --transformation offset per label suggests scroll parallax; nav toggle 'Shop Signs' shows/hides the labels layer
reconstruction.content: Fictional Italian hotels and shops (Naples, Palermo, Alicante, Genève, Berlin)

instances.look: On sage green, 'Weights & Sizes' then five columns of the word 'Arteria' cascading from tiny to large in each weight, alternating charcoal and white, so each column forms a diagonal wedge; the nine weight names in a row underneath
instances.ux: Columns slide down and fade in one by one when the section enters
instances.learn: Combine weight and size in one figure: a size cascade per weight makes the family read as a pattern of wedges

instances.look: Two topics on red. 'Principles': 'C9SGS3Jcersasa' and a giant 'REF REF' in Black and Thin, with a side note 'Your headlines will be perfectly aligned.' and a '☒ Construction' checkbox that draws alignment lines through them. 'Human Drawings': 'Geometrica' repeated at growing sizes, then a huge pale 'oeaoe' with a grey strict-geometric outline behind it, captioned 'Compare Arteria with a strict geometric construction in grey', with checkboxes 'Human drawings better for my eyes' and 'Construction'
instances.ux: Checkboxes toggle the guide overlay and swap between the drawn Arteria shapes and the geometric version; the 'Geometrica' stack grows and fades as you scroll
instances.learn: Let the visitor flip a construction overlay on and off over giant letters: alignment and optical correction become visible in one click

reconstruction.typography: Samples: 'C9SGS3J…' ~200px Thin→Black mixed; 'REF REF' ~500px Black + Thin white; 'oeaoe' ~420px pale grey; captions ~32px Arteria Light charcoal; checkbox labels same with a capsule-shaped box glyph
reconstruction.behaviour: 'Construction' toggles .overlay guide layers (thin rules at baseline, x-height, cap height); 'Human drawings' swaps details-01.svg vs the geometric outline; the 'Geometrica' images scale from 10% to 80% width with opacity tied to scroll
reconstruction.content: Two design principles: aligned heights across weights, and a fluid, hand-drawn take on geometric construction
reconstruction.assets: SVG samples (details-01…05.svg, details_hover-02.svg) and overlay guide layers

instances.look: 'Alphabet' on green: six full-width white lines of glyphs in Arteria Light: accented lowercase, f-ligatures and Th/st/sp ligatures, accented caps, short caps, two numeral sets with currency, and a line of circled figures, arrows and dingbats
instances.learn: Run each glyph category as one justified line at display size; a compressed face fits a whole category per line
